online.title: Incident Investigation with Agentic Graphs: Cutting Triage from 45 to 5 Minutes
online.blurb: This case study walkthrough shows how an SRE team used a multi-agent AI framework to automate the full incident lifecycle (detection, triage, communication, mitigation, and RCA), cutting MTTR from about 45 minutes to under 5. We'll cover the architecture, how agents collaborate, share memory, and manage context, and how remediation runs safely in production with human-in-the-loop oversight.

online.title: Exploring AI Ethics Through Fiction; Refactoring Old Games with Gemini and Claude: Part 2
online.registration: Free registration with Bevy Virtual Conference

RSVP now!
